results.fact: High camp location for this route (Star Lake vs Boiling Lake basin)
results.evidence: Every narrative field names Star Lake (just over Fish Creek Pass on this route's own approach) as the camp, which matches SummitPost (camping on the far side of the pass around Star Lake) and thirst4adventure (campsites in the Star Lake basin). The bivy[] list is the shared Sawtooth regional list: Boiling Lake basin and Prince Creek (boat-in) serve Courtney only on the lake-side Chelan Summit trail approach, and Oval Lakes basin only on the northern Oval/Eagle Creek approach; Scatter Lake, Reynolds Creek, Libby Lake, Upper Eagle Lake/Horsehead Pass and Bird Creek Camp do not serve this route. The list lacks the Star Lake camp this route actually uses. Left for the catalog-wide bivy class.

results.fact: Pass-to-summit distance: beta/pitch_detail 0.4 mi vs waypoint distMi 7.4 -> 8.5 (1.1 mi)
results.evidence: beta and pitch_detail say ~0.4 mi from the pass to the summit (the two pins are ~0.42 mi apart in a straight line), but the waypoints put the pass at 7.4 mi and the summit at 8.5 mi, and the round trip is stated as 17 mi. Sources give ~1,000 ft of gain from the pass but no pass-to-summit mileage, so the waypoint distMi values were not changed.

results.fact: CAMPING & BIVY list is for a different drainage/route cluster
results.evidence: This route camps in Crystal Creek Basin (outside the Enchantment permit area) from the Ingalls Creek Trailhead, or at Crystal Lake from the plateau. The bivy[] list is the Colchuck/Dragontail regional list: Colchuck Lake designated sites, the Dragontail north-side bivies, Shield Lake and the Bridge Creek/Eightmile campgrounds do not serve this route; Perfection/Inspiration Lake and Gnome Tarn serve it only for a party coming in over the Enchantment Plateau to Crystal Lake. None covers the Crystal Creek Basin camp. Left for the catalog-wide bivy class.

Fantasia Saddle/Fantasia Pond and Chessmen Notch are real features on the two genuine exits from the tower's top: traverse east to Fantasia Saddle and descend (likely with a rappel) to Fantasia Pond, or continue over the Westernmost Chessman and scramble around to Chessmen Notch, the Enchantment Plateau and Crystal Lake, which is the same Westernmost Chessman option the descent fields name. Eric's Base Camp independently places Fantasia Saddle (~7,600 ft) and Fantasia Pond on McClellan's west side.

results.correct_value: season 'Jun-Sep'; approach variant season 'Late June to September; axe before mid-July'
results.evidence: Documented June ascents exist: a CascadeClimbers trip report of the SW Rib dated 6/28/2012 and a Mountain Project photo of a June 2025 ascent; SummitPost advises an ice axe before mid-July, i.e. the route is climbed in early season. So the June start in best_season and climate is right, and season 'Jul-Sep' (and the approach variant's self-contradictory 'Mid-July to September; axe before Jul') are the outliers.
